products.title: Mug - Ruan Hoffmann Sweetheart
products.description_html:
Bold and witty, the BONJOUR SWEETHEART & BONJOUR MOTHERFUCKER mugs elevate the everyday ritual of drinking coffee or tea. Each mug holds 13.5 oz (40 cl) of your favourite beverage, offering a generous size for leisurely sipping. Available individually or as a set of two, these mugs bring an irreverent sense of humour into your routine, blending playful design with the sophistication of royal blue and 24K gold accents.

  • 4.25H x 3.25D in (11H x 8D cm)
